summary: אָתוֹן names a female donkey. Jacob counts the females separately from the males in his gift to Esau.

senses.definition: A donkey of the female sex.

evidence.note: Jacob pairs twenty אֲתֹנֹת with ten עְיָרִם in a list that also counts cows separately from bulls.
Abram’s possessions include אֲתֹנֹת alongside other livestock.
